envelope.description: Every response is wrapped in this shape (ApiResponseDto<T>). 'data' holds the actual payload described per-route below.

pagedList.description: Every list route's 'data' is this shape (PagedList<T> serializes as an array with extra fields). Pagination info also comes back in the 'Pagination' response header as JSON: { currentPage, itemsPerPage, totalItems, totalPages }.

shape.items: T[] (the array itself — PagedList<T> extends List<T>, so in JSON it's a plain array with currentPage/totalPages/pageSize/totalCount as extra properties on it)

odataEnvelope.description: Exception to the ApiResponseDto<T> envelope above: GET /api/report/inventoryBufferManagement is OData ([EnableQuery]), not wrapped. Built for TanStack Table + odata-query — $filter/$orderby/$top/$skip/$count run in SQL, not in-memory, since the underlying table can hold up to ~1M rows.

queryParams.dateStart: string (ISO date) | null (optional filter, matches EndDate >= dateStart)
queryParams.dateEnd: string (ISO date) | null (optional filter, matches StartDate <= dateEnd)

itemShape.idTag: number | null (robot-only, no FK relation, log-only)
itemShape.idReason: number | null (robot-only, no FK relation, log-only)

queryParams.includePast: boolean (default false) — when false, holidays with Date < today are excluded

routes.notes: Scoped to the authenticated user's own Workspace rows (Approved = true), joined to CenterProduct (via IdProduct+IdCenter) for the AllocationGroup and to Product for Weight/Volume/Value/Pallet. A group's weighted metric (Weight/Volume/Value/Pallet) comes back null if ANY item contributing to that group is missing that Product property (or, for Pallet, has it as 0).

Runs the 'PriorizedAllocation' redistribution algorithm over the authenticated user's approved Workspace items for that AllocationGroup, then persists the resulting quantities back onto each Workspace row (OptimizedQuantity) - always in raw units, regardless of adjustmentType. If the group's current total (converted to adjustmentType's unit for the comparison only) is above `limit`, quantities are walked down one PackQuantity at a time starting from the item with the highest buffer percentage, never going below the floor set by `stopCondition` (Zero=0, Moq=item.Moq, OnePackQuantity=item.PackQuantity, always in raw units) and never dropping the group's converted total below `limit`. If below `limit`, quantities are walked up starting from the item with the lowest buffer percentage, never pushing the converted total above `limit`. If already equal to `limit`, nothing changes. adjustmentType only changes what the group total is measured in when comparing against `limit`: Unit (default) uses the raw approved quantity as-is; Weight/Volume/Value multiply each item's approved quantity by the matching Product property; Pallet divides it by Product.Pallet. An item whose Product is missing the property adjustmentType needs (or has Pallet = 0) is left untouched, same as an item with PackQuantity <= 0. Each item's own PackQuantity (in raw units) determines its step size.

itemShape.greenAnalytical: number | null (ceiling(GreenZone) — GreenZone alone, not RedZone + GreenZone)
itemShape.yellowExcessAnalytical: number | null (0 if GreenZone >= YellowZone, else YellowZone - GreenZone)
itemShape.redExcessAnalytical: number | null (0 if TopOfGreen <= 0, else TopOfGreen - (RedZone + GreenZone + YellowExcessAnalytical); renamed from redSafeExcessAnalytical 2026-09-20)

itemShape.orderLeadtime: number | null (computed: days between creationDate and deliveryDate; null when deliveryDate is not set)
itemShape.daysToReceive: number (computed: 0 if deliveryDate is null/already past, else days until deliveryDate; depends on today's date)
itemShape.daysLate: number (computed: 0 if deliveryDate is null/today/future, else days since deliveryDate; depends on today's date)

queryParams.$filter: string (optional, OData filter expression, e.g. $filter=stock gt 100 and centerCode eq 'C1')
queryParams.selectedCenters: number[] (optional, e.g. selectedCenters=1&selectedCenters=2) — master center filter, applied before $filter and not overridable by it: rows outside this list never appear, even if $filter asks for idCenter eq 3 on a center not in the list. Omit or send empty to not restrict.

routes.responseData: See 'odataEnvelope' above — NOT ApiResponseDto<T>, NOT a PagedList. { value: InventoryBufferManagementRow[], '@odata.count'?: number }

itemShape.availableStock: number (computed: stock - reservedStock; feeds netflow and coverageDays — executionBufferPercentage/executionBufferColor still use raw stock)
itemShape.greenAnalytical: number | null (ceiling(GreenZone) — GreenZone alone, not RedZone + GreenZone)
itemShape.yellowExcessAnalytical: number | null (0 if GreenZone >= YellowZone, else YellowZone - GreenZone)
itemShape.redExcessAnalytical: number | null (0 if TopOfGreen <= 0, else TopOfGreen - (RedZone + GreenZone + YellowExcessAnalytical); renamed from redSafeExcessAnalytical 2026-09-20)
itemShape.topOfYellowExcessAnalytical: number | null (ceiling(RedSafeAnalytical + YellowSafeAnalytical + GreenAnalytical + YellowExcessAnalytical); added 2026-09-20)
itemShape.topOfRedExcessAnalytical: number | null (ceiling(RedSafeAnalytical + YellowSafeAnalytical + GreenAnalytical + YellowExcessAnalytical + RedExcessAnalytical); added 2026-09-20)
itemShape.netflow: number (computed via UtilsDdmrp.CalculateNetflow(availableStock, qualifiedDemand, inbounds) — uses availableStock = stock - reservedStock, not raw stock)
itemShape.systemOptimizedOrderQuantity: number (the system-suggested optimized order quantity, before any Workspace override)
itemShape.optimizedOrderQuantity: number (Workspace.optimizedQuantity for the current user when set, else systemOptimizedOrderQuantity)
itemShape.approved: boolean (Workspace.approved for the current user; false when no Workspace row exists)
itemShape.simulatedNetflowBufferPercentage: number ((Netflow + (Workspace.approved ? Workspace.optimizedQuantity : 0)) / TopOfGreen, for the current user; 0 when TopOfGreen = 0)
itemShape.simulatedNetflowBufferColor: BufferColor (enum string) (same zone classification as netflowBufferColor, but against SimulatedNetflow instead of Netflow)
itemShape.coverageDays: number (computed via UtilsDdmrp.CalculateCoverageDays(availableStock, adu) — uses availableStock = stock - reservedStock, not raw stock)
itemShape.executionBufferPercentage: number (still computed against raw stock, not availableStock)
itemShape.executionBufferColor: BufferColor (enum string) (still computed against raw stock, not availableStock)
itemShape.analyticalBufferColor: AnalyticalBufferColor (enum string) (computed via UtilsDdmrp.CalculateAnalyticalBufferColor against raw stock and the 5 topOf*Analytical fields; NoColor when topOfRedExcessAnalytical = 0 (buffer not computed yet), Black when stock <= 0 (stockout, buffer already computed); added 2026-09-20, Black split out from NoColor same day)

queryParams.$filter: string (optional, same OData filter expression accepted by inventoryBufferManagement — only $filter is allowed here, $orderby/$top/$skip/$count are rejected)
queryParams.selectedCenters: number[] (optional, same master center filter as inventoryBufferManagement, applied the same way before $filter)

routes.responseData: ApiResponseDto<InventoryBufferManagementColorSummaryResult> (normal envelope, unlike inventoryBufferManagement — no $top/$skip/$count so no ODataResult needed). Snapshot counts by color, grouped over the same (optionally $filter-ed) CenterProduct set as inventoryBufferManagement, not historical.

itemShape.netflow: BufferColorSummaryRow[] — [{ color: BufferColor (enum string), count: number }], one row per distinct netflowBufferColor value present
itemShape.execution: BufferColorSummaryRow[] — same shape, grouped by executionBufferColor
itemShape.analytical: AnalyticalBufferColorSummaryRow[] — [{ color: AnalyticalBufferColor (enum string), count: number }], grouped by analyticalBufferColor; added 2026-09-20

routes.responseData: OpenOrderRow[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). Scope: deletedAt == null AND quantity > deliveredQuantity (open) AND isInbound == true (inbound-only report; outbound is a separate future report) AND isFictional == false (always — no way to opt into fictional orders on this route)

itemShape.orderLeadtime: number | null (computed: days between creationDate and deliveryDate; null when deliveryDate is not set)
itemShape.daysToReceive: number (computed: 0 if deliveryDate is null/already past, else days until deliveryDate; depends on today's date)
itemShape.daysLate: number (computed: 0 if deliveryDate is null/today/future, else days since deliveryDate; depends on today's date)
itemShape.timeBuffer: number | null (computed: (today - (deliveryDate+1 - orderLeadtime)) / max(1, orderLeadtime); null when deliveryDate or orderLeadtime is not set)
itemShape.timeBufferColor: BufferColor (enum string) | null (computed from timeBuffer: >1 Black, >0.66 Red, >0.33 Yellow, >0 Green, else NoColor; null when timeBuffer is null)
itemShape.executionBuffer: number | null (computed: (centerProduct.stock + sum of pendingQuantity of earlier open inbound orders for the same product+destinyCenter, where their id < this id AND their deliveryDate <= this deliveryDate) / centerProduct.topOfYellowExecution; null when topOfYellowExecution is 0/missing, or this order has no deliveryDate/matching centerProduct)
itemShape.executionBufferColor: BufferColor (enum string) | null (computed via CalculateBufferColor using the same qt = centerProduct.stock + earlier pending (not divided) against centerProduct.topOfRedExecution/topOfYellowExecution/topOfGreenExecution; null in every case executionBuffer is null)

routes.responseData: InventoryHistoryRow[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). One row per History day within [dateStart, dateEnd] for that (idCenter, idProduct), UNIONed with one extra 'today' row built live from CenterProduct + Order (History only gets a row once the Robot has run for that day; the 'today' row fills the gap before that day's run happens). Sorted by date ascending. The 'today' row is omitted entirely if no matching CenterProduct exists.

itemShape.ordersInTransit: number | null (History.OpenInbounds for past days; for today, sum of Quantity - DeliveredQuantity of open, non-fictional, inbound orders for this idProduct/idDestinyCenter=idCenter)
itemShape.consumption: number | null (History.Consumption for past days; for today, MAX(OpenOutbounds, Adu) where OpenOutbounds = sum of Quantity - DeliveredQuantity of open, non-fictional, outbound orders for this idProduct/idOriginCenter=idCenter)
itemShape.inventoryDays: number | null (computed: Stock / Adu, null when Adu is null/0)
itemShape.netflow: number (computed via UtilsDdmrp.CalculateNetflow(Stock, QualifiedDemand, OrdersInTransit), null fields treated as 0)

queryParams.useAdu: boolean (default true) — include adu in the MAX comparison that determines outbound
queryParams.useForecast: boolean (default true) — include projectedConsumption in the MAX comparison that determines outbound
queryParams.useOutbounds: boolean (default true) — include outboundOrders in the MAX comparison that determines outbound
queryParams.useInbounds: boolean (default true) — when false, inbound is not added to closingStock (the row's inbound field still shows the raw pending quantity)
queryParams.accumulateInboundsToday: boolean (default false) — when true, an inbound order with deliveryDate before today is bucketed onto today instead of its own date
queryParams.accumulateOutboundsToday: boolean (default false) — same as accumulateInboundsToday, for outbound orders
queryParams.useFictionalOrders: boolean (default true) — when true, orders with isFictional=true count in inbound/outboundOrders; when false, only real orders count. Unlike every other report (openOrders/inventoryBufferManagement/inventoryHistory), which always exclude fictional orders with no toggle, this one counts them by default.

routes.responseData: ProjectedStockAlertRow[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). One row per calendar day in [dateStart, dateEnd], a forward-looking day-by-day stock simulation for that (idProduct, idCenter) — each day's openingStock is the previous day's closingStock. 404 if no CenterProduct exists for (idProduct, idCenter); 400 if dateEnd < dateStart. Sorted by date ascending.

itemShape.adu: number (fixed for the whole period, CenterProduct.Adu, 0 if null)
itemShape.redZoneExecution: number (fixed for the whole period, CenterProduct.RedZoneExecution, 0 if null — reference only, not used in any formula below)
itemShape.yellowZoneExecution: number (fixed for the whole period, CenterProduct.YellowZoneExecution, 0 if null — reference only, not used in any formula below)
itemShape.greenZoneExecution: number (fixed for the whole period, CenterProduct.GreenZoneExecution, 0 if null — reference only, not used in any formula below)
itemShape.projectedConsumption: number (Forecast for the day, exploded across business days of its interval via Calendar — same rule as GET /api/forecast)
itemShape.inbound: number (sum of Quantity - DeliveredQuantity of non-deleted inbound orders for this idProduct/idDestinyCenter=idCenter with deliveryDate = this day, or today if accumulateInboundsToday=true and deliveryDate is before today — fictional orders included unless useFictionalOrders=false; raw value, always shown regardless of useInbounds)
itemShape.outboundOrders: number (same as inbound, but IsOutbound/idOriginCenter=idCenter and accumulateOutboundsToday — the raw pending order demand for the day, before the MAX below, always shown regardless of useOutbounds)
itemShape.outbound: number (computed: MAX of whichever of {adu, outboundOrders, projectedConsumption} are enabled via useAdu/useOutbounds/useForecast; 0 if all three are disabled — the quantity actually consumed from stock this day)
itemShape.openingStock: number (CenterProduct.Stock on the first day of the period, else the previous row's closingStock)
itemShape.executionBufferColor: BufferColor (enum string) (computed via UtilsDdmrp.CalculateBufferColor(closingStock, CenterProduct.topOfRedExecution, topOfYellowExecution, topOfGreenExecution), 0 for any unset zone)

queryParams.idCenters: number[] (optional, repeat the param e.g. ?idCenters=1&idCenters=2) — restricts to one or more centers; omitted/empty = no center filter
queryParams.mode: BufferPenetrationMode (enum string, optional, default 'Netflow') — 'Netflow': quantity = CalculateNetflow(Stock, QualifiedDemand, OpenInbounds), zones = RedZoneBase+RedZoneSafe/YellowZone/GreenZone. 'Execution': quantity = Stock ONLY (QualifiedDemand/OpenInbounds ignored, no Netflow involved), zones = RedZoneExecution/YellowZoneExecution/GreenZoneExecution (same formulas as CenterProduct's execution zones: RedZoneExecution = YellowZoneExecution = ceiling((RedZoneBase+RedZoneSafe)/2), GreenZoneExecution = YellowZone).

routes.responseData: BufferPenetrationRow[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). One row per (idProduct, idCenter) pair that has at least one History row in [dateStart, dateEnd] — unlike inventoryHistory/projectedStockAlert, not scoped to a single pair; idCenters/idProduct just narrow it, same as openOrders. For each History day in range, the quantity and zone tops (picked per 'mode', see queryParams) are reconstructed from that day's own History snapshot columns (Stock/QualifiedDemand/OpenInbounds/RedBaseZone/RedSafeZone/YellowZone/GreenZone, nulls treated as 0) and classified via UtilsDdmrp.CalculateBufferColor; days with no zones computed yet fall into NoColor (topOfGreen=0), they still count toward quantityDays. No 'today' row injected — only counts days that already have a History row. 400 if dateEnd < dateStart.

itemShape.quantityDays: number (count of History rows for this pair within the range)
itemShape.daysRedAndBlack: number (computed: daysRed + daysBlack, not a separate CalculateBufferColor classification)

queryParams.idCenters: number[] (optional, repeat the param e.g. ?idCenters=1&idCenters=2) — restricts to one or more centers; omitted/empty = no center filter

routes.responseData: ItemsByBufferColorHistoryResult (a single object, NOT a plain array and NOT a PagedList — no pagination): { netflow: BufferColorHistoryDayRow[], execution: BufferColorHistoryDayRow[] }. Each list has one row per day in [dateStart, dateEnd] that has at least one History row (matching idCenters/idProduct if given) — same scope/data source as bufferPenetration, but aggregated the other way around: bufferPenetration is one row per item counting days per color, this is one row per day counting items per color, with each of the 6 BufferColor values as its own field on that row (0 when no item landed in that color that day) — a day with no History data simply doesn't appear in either list. Unlike bufferPenetration there is no 'mode' param: both perspectives are always computed together, as two separate lists rather than one 'mode' choice. 400 if dateEnd < dateStart.

itemShape.netflow: BufferColorHistoryDayRow[] — colors classified via quantity = CalculateNetflow(Stock, QualifiedDemand, OpenInbounds), zones = RedZoneBase+RedZoneSafe/YellowZone/GreenZone
itemShape.execution: BufferColorHistoryDayRow[] — colors classified via quantity = Stock ONLY, zones = RedZoneExecution/YellowZoneExecution/GreenZoneExecution (same formulas as bufferPenetration's 'Execution' mode)

BufferColorHistoryDayRow.red: number (count of items whose color this day was Red)
BufferColorHistoryDayRow.yellow: number (count of items whose color this day was Yellow)
BufferColorHistoryDayRow.green: number (count of items whose color this day was Green)
BufferColorHistoryDayRow.blue: number (count of items whose color this day was Blue)
BufferColorHistoryDayRow.black: number (count of items whose color this day was Black)
BufferColorHistoryDayRow.noColor: number (count of items whose color this day was NoColor)

queryParams.idCenters: number[] (required, repeat the param e.g. ?idCenters=1&idCenters=2) — unlike bufferPenetration/itemsByBufferColorHistory, there is no 'all centers' default here; 400 if omitted/empty

routes.responseData: AccumulatedBufferHistoryRow[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). One row per Date in [dateStart, dateEnd], summing every metric across every (idProduct, idCenter) History row within idCenters whose RedBaseZone + RedSafeZone > 0 (nulls treated as 0; items with no red zone computed yet are excluded entirely, not summed as 0). Every product is included (no idProduct filter) — the row has no idProduct/idCenter of its own, it's a sum across all qualifying pairs for that date. 400 if dateEnd < dateStart or idCenters is empty.

itemShape.executionRedZone: number (sum of ceiling((RedBaseZone+RedSafeZone)/2) across qualifying items)
itemShape.executionYellowZone: number (sum, always equal to executionRedZone per item before summing — same intentional duplication as CenterProduct.RedZoneExecution/YellowZoneExecution)
itemShape.executionGreenZone: number (sum of YellowZone across qualifying items)
itemShape.netflowRedZone: number (sum of RedBaseZone+RedSafeZone across qualifying items)
itemShape.netflowYellowZone: number (sum of YellowZone across qualifying items)
itemShape.netflowGreenZone: number (sum of GreenZone across qualifying items)
itemShape.redSafeAnalytical: number (sum of ceiling(netflowRedZone/2) per item — same formula as CenterProduct.RedSafeAnalytical, fed netflowRedZone)
itemShape.greenAnalytical: number (sum of ceiling(netflowGreenZone) per item — matches CenterProduct.GreenAnalytical, GreenZone alone, not RedZone + GreenZone)
itemShape.yellowExcessAnalytical: number (sum per item of: 0 if netflowGreenZone >= netflowYellowZone, else netflowYellowZone - netflowGreenZone)
itemShape.redExcessAnalytical: number (sum per item of: 0 if topOfGreenNetflow <= 0, else topOfGreenNetflow - (netflowRedZone+netflowGreenZone+yellowExcessAnalytical), where topOfGreenNetflow = netflowRedZone+netflowYellowZone+netflowGreenZone)
itemShape.averageProjectedInventory: number (sum of netflowRedZone + netflowGreenZone/2 per item — DDMRP Average Projected On-Hand formula)
itemShape.availableStock: number (sum of (History.Stock - History.ReservedStock) across qualifying items, nulls treated as 0 — NOT raw Stock)
itemShape.netflow: number (sum of UtilsDdmrp.CalculateNetflow(AvailableStock, QualifiedDemand, OpenInbounds) per item)
itemShape.excessStock: number (sum of max(0, AvailableStock - (netflowRedZone+netflowYellowZone+netflowGreenZone)) per item)
itemShape.excessStockAnalytical: number (sum of max(0, AvailableStock - (netflowRedZone+netflowGreenZone)) per item — same as excessStock but without the yellow zone)
itemShape.maximumOscillationRange: number (sum of netflowRedZone + netflowGreenZone per item — note: yellow is NOT included)

routes.permissionNote: Bootstrap route — deliberately excluded from [RequirePermission] (see the other /api/permission/* routes) so no role can get permanently locked out of managing permissions.
routes.responseData: PermissionGetDto[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). The full catalog of route:method permission keys, ordered by module then id.

itemShape.id: string (the permission key, format "{route}:{HTTP method}" — no leading "api/" and no "{id}"/route-parameter segments, e.g. "center:PUT", "centerproduct/allocation-group:PATCH")

routes.permissionNote: Bootstrap route — no [RequirePermission], same reason as GET /api/permission.
routes.responseData: PermissionGetDto[] (plain array, NOT a PagedList — no pagination). The permissions currently assigned to this role. 404 if the role doesn't exist.

routes.permissionNote: Bootstrap route — no [RequirePermission], same reason as GET /api/permission.
routes.responseData: string[] (plain array of permission keys). Lists the exact key each currently [RequirePermission]-marked action will check at runtime — a copy-paste reference for adding new Permission rows via HasData in a migration, not a runtime-registration endpoint. Empty until at least one action carries [RequirePermission].
